Tool.dxcfxMove: Move an area (Alt: move a copy)
Tool.dxcfxClear: Delete all effect areas on this scene

Hint.dxcfxPick: Click an area to make it the current one. Double-click it to open its effect. Delete removes it, Esc lets go.
Hint.dxcfxMove: Drag an area to move it with its effect. Hold Alt to drag a copy, Shift to move it freely (no grid steps). Double-click opens its effect.
Hint.dxcfxBrush: Drag to paint, click for a dot. Paints into the current area, or starts a new one.
Hint.dxcfxWall: Click-drag the first stretch, then click to add corners. Double-click to finish. The wall is as thick as the brush. Hold Alt to cut it out, Shift to place freely.
Hint.dxcfxRect: Drag to draw a rectangle. Hold Alt to cut it out, Shift not to snap to the grid.
Hint.dxcfxEllipse: Drag to draw an ellipse. Hold Alt to cut it out, Shift not to snap to the grid.
Hint.dxcfxPolygon: Click-drag the first side, then click to add corners. Double-click or click the first corner to close. Right-click removes a corner. Hold Alt to cut it out.
Hint.dxcfxErase: Paint to remove from the current area (or from every area under the eraser when none is current).
Hint.other: Paint areas on the map and give them an effect. Ctrl+Z undoes.

App.ExcludeHint: Hide the effects of every area below this one in the list where this is painted (for example inside buildings). Areas above it are not affected.
App.ExclusionText: Exclusion zone: where this is painted, the effects of the areas below it in the Effect Painter's list are hidden (rain over the map, an exclusion zone over each building). It can have an effect of its own, shown inside it. Areas above it in the list, or with "Ignore exclusion zones" ticked, still show inside it.
App.NoLayersText: This exclusion zone hides the effects below it and has no effect of its own. Add one to fill the zone, such as dust motes or firelight in the room. For candles or a fireplace, paint them as their own areas.
App.IgnoreExclusionsHint: This area's effect is never hidden by an exclusion zone, wherever it is in the list, e.g. candles inside a house.
